title: EmbeddingCacheConfig
description:
Operator config for the OSS embedding semantic cache, parsed from an `ai_proxy` action's `semantic_cache:` block.

Unknown keys are rejected, so a stale `streaming:` or `key_template:` entry fails the load instead of silently doing nothing.

enabled.description: Opt-in switch. The cache is inert unless this is `true`.

backend.description: Which store backs this cache. Defaults to `memory`.

threshold.description: Minimum cosine similarity (`0.0..=1.0`) for a near-duplicate prompt to be served from cache. Defaults to 0.85.

ttl_secs.description: Entry time-to-live in seconds. Defaults to 3600.

max_entries.description: Memory LRU capacity, 1 through [`MAX_SEMANTIC_CACHE_ENTRIES`]. Defaults to 1024. Redis and mesh accept the field for configuration compatibility and bound entries by TTL instead.

max_response_bytes.description: Optional cap on a cached response body in bytes, 1 through [`MAX_SEMANTIC_RESPONSE_BYTES`]. Omitted preserves the current memory behavior; Redis and mesh still enforce the fixed wire-entry ceiling.

lsh.description: Candidate-generation bounds for the distributed backends.

source.description: Where prompt embeddings come from. Defaults to `provider` so existing configs are unchanged.

embedding.description: Embedding provider and model used to vectorize prompts (for `source: provider`).

SemanticCacheBackend.description: Which store backs the semantic cache for this action.

oneOf.description: Process-local LRU with a full same-namespace cosine scan. The default, so an existing configuration keeps today's behavior.
Shared Redis, reusing the validated `proxy.l2_cache_settings` connection.
The current cluster mesh, routed by key prefix over the authenticated transport.

SemanticLshConfig.description:
Deterministic locality-sensitive hashing bounds used for candidate generation on the distributed backends.

The memory backend keeps its full same-namespace scan, so these values do not change the recall of an existing memory deployment.

tables.description: Number of independent hash tables, 1 through [`MAX_LSH_TABLES`].

planes.description: Random projection planes per table, 1 through [`MAX_LSH_PLANES`].

candidates_per_bucket.description: Candidates read from one bucket, 1 through [`MAX_CANDIDATES_PER_BUCKET`].

seed.description: Seed for the deterministic projections, 1 through 128 bytes. Two nodes must share this value to agree on buckets.

EmbeddingSource.description: Where the semantic cache gets prompt embeddings.

oneOf.description: Call an AI embedding provider's `/v1/embeddings` API (default, back-compat). Costs money and egresses the prompt.
Call the local classifier sidecar's `Embed` RPC. Free, no egress.
Run an in-process tract embedder. Single-binary, but loads a model into the proxy address space (opt-in).

Call a standalone OpenAI-compatible `/v1/embeddings` endpoint that is not one of the origin's chat providers (another sbproxy, OpenRouter, ...). Decoupled from `providers`; carries its own URL and auth.

EmbeddingProviderConfig.description: Which provider and model computes prompt embeddings.

provider.description: Provider name (must match an entry in the handler's `providers`).

SidecarEmbeddingConfig.description:
Sidecar embedding endpoint config (for `source: sidecar`).

The sidecar is local by contract: `endpoint` must be an absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL whose host is a literal loopback address and whose port is explicit.

model.description: Embedding model id (empty selects the sidecar default).

timeout_ms.description: Per-call timeout in milliseconds, 1 through [`MAX_EMBEDDING_TIMEOUT_MS`]. Defaults to 500.

InprocessEmbeddingConfig.description:
In-process embedder config (for `source: inprocess`).

Provide explicit `model_path` and `tokenizer_path`. Known-model auto-download for the in-process embedder is a follow-up; until then the operator points at on-disk ONNX and tokenizer files.

model_path.description: Path to the ONNX model file.

max_model_bytes.description: Max model size in bytes (guard). None uses the engine default.

OpenAiEmbeddingConfig.description:
Standalone OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint config (for `source: openai`).

Unlike `source: provider`, this is not tied to the origin's chat `providers`: point `base_url` at any OpenAI-compatible `/v1/embeddings` route (another sbproxy, OpenRouter, ...). Auth defaults to `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`; set `auth_header` and `auth_prefix` for `api-key` or `x-api-key` style endpoints, or omit `api_key` and carry the auth in `headers`.

Public destinations are the default. A private or loopback destination requires the explicit `allow_private_base_url` opt-in and is still resolved and pinned on every call.

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. `https://api.openai.com/v1`. `/v1/embeddings` is appended (an overlapping trailing `/v1` is collapsed, matching the chat-provider path join).

timeout_ms.description: Per-call timeout in milliseconds, 1 through [`MAX_EMBEDDING_TIMEOUT_MS`]. Defaults to 2000.

api_key.description: API key. Interpolated (`${VAR}` or vault) by the config layer. When set, sent as `{auth_header}: {auth_prefix}{api_key}`.

auth_prefix.description: Prefix prepended to the key in the auth header. Defaults to `Bearer `; set to `""` for raw-key headers like `api-key` or `x-api-key`.

headers.description: Extra static headers, sent verbatim and applied after the auth header (e.g. OpenRouter `HTTP-Referer` and `X-Title`, or a custom auth header when `api_key` is omitted). Interpolated by the config layer.

allow_private_base_url.description: Permit a private or loopback embedding destination. Public-only by default.
